mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, kb_id, tenant_id, chunk_index, content, content_hash, metadata, token_count, is_active, created_at FROM kb_chunk WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY chunk_index ASC

SELECT id, doc_id, kb_id, tenant_id, chunk_index, content, content_hash, metadata, token_count, is_active, created_at FROM kb_chunk WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY doc_id ASC, chunk_index ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_chunk (doc_id, kb_id, tenant_id, chunk_index, content, content_hash, metadata, token_count, is_active, created_at) VALUES (#{docId}, #{kbId}, #{tenantId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{metadata}::jsonb, #{tokenCount}, #{isActive}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, kb_id, tenant_id, chunk_index, content, content_hash, metadata, token_count, is_active, created_at FROM kb_chunk WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
